fail_closed_rules: Sold Post and Sold Prior without consideration are not assigned prices.
Withdrawn Post and Archive records are not represented as completed sales or current availability.
Unreadable official update endpoints are not reconstructed or guessed.
Agreements for lease, delayed commencement and proposed AST terms are not represented as fully executed current occupation without the stated conditions.
Seller top-up during rent-free periods is not represented as tenant-paid rent.
Current tenant liquidation is preserved as a post-auction covenant caveat and does not rewrite the historical sale record.
Tenant options, outstanding reviews, funding breaks and CPI-linked future rents are not silently resolved.
Vacant areas are not represented as let or income-producing.
Historic or subject-to-consent planning opportunities are not represented as implemented or valued outcomes.
Active registry status and charge status do not imply covenant strength or property-level lease performance.
Gross and annualised published rents are not converted into net operating income.
Legal-pack EPC, restrictions, update and break details are not filled by inference.
No business or parcel row was written by the maintenance/control slot.
